edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner in transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer uses msg.sender as the key into the balances mapping.
approve uses msg.sender as the owner key into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom debits the allowance of the caller msg.sender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
onlyOwner modifier on transferAnyERC20Token checks msg.sender against owner.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
YouTube constructor runs the inherited Owned constructor which sets owner.
Constructor assigns the symbol string.
Constructor assigns the name string.
Constructor assigns decimals = 18.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed mint amount.
Constructor mints the full supply into balances of the fixed deploy address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer writes sender and recipient entries of balances.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom writes source and destination entries of balances.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.safeSub on balance and allowance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.safeAdd on the recipient balance.
safeAdd performs unchecked addition that is only guarded by require(c >= a).
safeSub performs subtraction that could underflow if the require were removed or bypassed.
safeMul performs multiplication whose overflow is only prevented by a require check.
approveAndCall executes an external call to receiveApproval before the transaction is complete.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
The receiveApproval callback gives the spender contract control and it can reenter transfer.
The receiveApproval callback can reenter transferFrom while allowance state is partially updated.
A malicious tokenAddress contract can reenter transfer during the external call.
safeAdd parameter a feeds the arithmetic operation.
safeAdd parameter b feeds the arithmetic operation.
safeAdd assigns its return local c.
safeSub parameter a feeds the arithmetic operation.
safeSub parameter b feeds the arithmetic operation.
safeSub assigns its return local c.
safeMul parameter a feeds the arithmetic operation.
safeMul parameter b feeds the arithmetic operation.
safeMul assigns its return local c.
safeDiv parameter a feeds the division.
safeDiv parameter b feeds the division.
safeDiv assigns its return local c.
transferOwnership parameter _newOwner is written into newOwner.
balanceOf parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping.
transfer parameter to is the recipient key in balances.
transfer parameter tokens is the amount moved.
transfer returns the local success flag.
approve parameter spender is the allowance key.
approve parameter tokens is the allowance value.
approve returns the local success flag.
transferFrom parameter from indexes balances and allowed.
transferFrom parameter to is the destination balance key.
transferFrom parameter tokens is the amount moved.
transferFrom returns the local success flag.
allowance parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping.
allowance parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping.
allowance returns the local remaining value.
approveAndCall parameter spender is both allowance key and callback target.
approveAndCall parameter tokens is the allowance and callback amount.
approveAndCall parameter data is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall returns the local success flag.
transferAnyERC20Token parameter tokenAddress is the target of the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token parameter tokens is the amount forwarded to the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token returns the local success flag.
